messages.snippet: Karen, Terms are now agreed: ex gratia £115,000, PILON £92,500, accrued holiday £7,115, outplacement
messages.subject: WC-00106 Hale - terms agreed
messages.plaintextBody:
Karen,

Terms are now agreed: ex gratia £115,000, PILON £92,500, accrued holiday £7,115, outplacement up to £5,000 and a £750 + VAT fee contribution. The first £30,000 of the ex gratia is being paid without deduction. I've asked Fiona's team to be ready to process payment within 28 days of signing. The engrossment will go out shortly for signature.

The claim will be withdrawn within 7 days of the agreement taking effect.

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher
Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0000
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
